name: fresh-file-explorer
description: Git-aware navigation: recent changes, branch-relative blame heatmap, branch compare, pickaxe diff search. Companion to GitLens — no telemetry, no AI buttons.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension runs Git commands and accesses the local filesystem, which requires a trusted workspace.

items.patternErrorMessage: Use a positive number of days (e.g. 14) or a duration token: 6h, 1d, 2w, 1mo, 1y.

freshFileExplorer.timeWindows.description: Time window options. Use a number of days (e.g. 14 = up to 14 days ago) or a duration token: 6h (hours), 1d (days), 2w (weeks), 1mo (months, ~30d), 1y (years, ~365d). 'Pending changes' is always available. Commit history up to your highest defined time window is preloaded in the background to enable near instant switching between windows.

freshFileExplorer.defaultGroupingMode.description: Default grouping mode for new workspaces. Changing this resets any per-workspace override.

enumDescriptions: Sort by most recent commit date
freshFileExplorer.defaultSortOrder.description: Default sort order for new workspaces. Changing this resets any per-workspace override.

freshFileExplorer.defaultOpenChangesMode.description: Default open-changes mode for new workspaces. When true, clicking a file opens its diff instead of the file itself. Changing this resets any per-workspace override.

freshFileExplorer.autoExpandDepth.description: Number of directory levels to automatically expand when the tree is loaded (0 = collapsed, 1 = root expanded, etc.)

freshFileExplorer.autoReveal.description: Automatically reveal and select the active editor's file in the Fresh Files tree when switching tabs.

freshFileExplorer.respectFilesExclude.description: Hide files matching each workspace folder's `files.exclude` setting, mirroring the VS Code Explorer. Per-folder settings are honored, so a folder added as its own workspace root can exclude its subprojects. Sibling (`when`-clause) excludes are not supported. Turn off to show every changed file regardless of `files.exclude`.

freshFileExplorer.aiCoAuthorEmails.markdownDescription: Additional `Co-authored-by` email addresses to treat as AI agents when filtering by AI co-authorship. Use this for in-house or custom agents not covered by the built-in table (which already detects Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, aider, Devin, and Codex). Matched case-insensitively as exact emails, e.g. `bot@yourcompany.com`.

enumDescriptions: Notify on any update, including patch releases
Notify on minor and major updates only
freshFileExplorer.notifyOn.description: Smallest version bump that triggers an 'updated to vX' notification with a 'What's New' button.

enumDescriptions: Show the repo-relative file path as the label (e.g. src/utils/pathUtils.ts)
Show only the filename as the label; the directory path is prepended to the description
freshFileExplorer.flatList.labelStyle.description: Controls what is shown as the primary label for each file in Flat List grouping mode.

freshFileExplorer.description.showDate.description: Show relative date in file description

freshFileExplorer.description.showAuthor.description: Show commit author in file description

freshFileExplorer.description.showCommit.description: Show commit hash in file description
Show commit message in file description

freshFileExplorer.description.showLineCh.description: Show line additions/deletions (+/-) in file descriptions for pending changes.

freshFileExplorer.showCurrentBranchSync.description: Show sync status warnings for current branch (indicating you need to push/pull)

freshFileExplorer.showBaseBranchSync.description: Show warnings when base branch has commits not in current branch (indicating you need to merge)

freshFileExplorer.branchCompare.autoFoll.description: Automatically add a live Branch Compare section for each repo or worktree whose current branch has diverged from its default branch (main/master). In-progress work — your own feature branch, a parallel worktree, anything checked out off main — shows up and updates live with no manual setup. Auto sections appear in the Branch Compare settings panel like any other comparison; use 'Stop Following' to dismiss one for the session, or edit one to keep it permanently.

freshFileExplorer.branchCompare.enableDi.description: Enable 'Open in External Diff Tool' for a whole repo section or folder in Branch Compare (git difftool --dir-diff). Off by default: this only works with diff tools that support directory comparison (e.g. WinMerge, Meld, Beyond Compare) — single-file tools configured as diff.tool will error or misbehave. The single-file 'Open in External Diff Tool' action is always available regardless of this setting.

freshFileExplorer.codeTelescopeIntegrati.description: When enabled, Fresh File Explorer will use Code Telescope instead of its own quick pick (CTRL+Q, F) to quickly search Fresh Files. Requires the Code Telescope extension (guichina.code-telescope).

freshFileExplorer.autoStageRename.description: Use git mv for renames so the rename is auto-staged. When disabled, uses a plain filesystem rename which shows as delete + add in git.

freshFileExplorer.heatmap.enabled.description: Color files by recency (heatmap). Recent files appear bright (cyan/blue), older files faded (gray). Colors appear in all views (Explorer, tabs, Fresh Files tree).

freshFileExplorer.statusBar.loading.description: Show the Fresh Files loading-progress entry in the status bar.

freshFileExplorer.statusBar.heatmap.description: Show the blame-heatmap entry in the status bar.

freshFileExplorer.blameHeatmap.autoApply.description: Automatically apply the last used blame heatmap mode (Absolute Age or Branch Changes) when you open or switch to a new editor tab. The branch ref selected during the last manual toggle is reused, so you won't be prompted again. Performance note — Absolute Age runs git blame on every new file (~100ms–2s depending on file size and history depth); Branch Changes adds a merge-base lookup and a branch commit-range query on top of that (~50–150ms extra, dominated by blame). This will not slow down tab opening, but may take a short while for the heatmap to show up.

freshFileExplorer.blameHeatmap.backgroun.description: Opacity of the per-line background color wash applied by the blame heatmap (0 = invisible, 1 = fully opaque). The gutter bar is unaffected. Recommended values are low (0.05-0.15)

freshFileExplorer.blameHeatmap.maxFileLi.description: Skip the blame heatmap for files with more lines than this limit. git blame on large files can be slow; raise this if you regularly work with bigger files and find the performance acceptable.

freshFileExplorer.incrementalTreeLoading.description: Update the fresh file tree progressively, adding data for each configured time window as it becomes available. When disabled, updates fire when repositories are found, when pending changes are ready, and when your selected time window is ready.

freshFileExplorer.gitTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for git operations. I consider it suspicious if you ever need to increase this number. Please open an issue.

freshFileExplorer.openSearchInEditor.description: Open searches in a Search Editor tab instead of the Search view

freshFileExplorer.searchPatternMaxLength.description: Maximum length for search include pattern per batch. When exceeded, files are split into multiple search editor tabs. This affects features 'search in fresh files' and 'search in found files' in cases where the search covers a large number of files.

freshFileExplorer.bulkActionConfirmThres.description: Bulk actions (e.g. Open All Changes, Open All Found Files) prompt for confirmation when they would act on more than this many files. Set to 0 to always confirm; raise it if you regularly open large sets without wanting the prompt.

enumDescriptions: Show your working tree on the left, baseline on the right.
Show baseline on the left, working tree on the right.
freshFileExplorer.branchCompare.workingT.description: Which side of the diff editor your working tree appears on when opening a Branch Compare change. The baseline-side content is the merge-base (common ancestor), so it is always at-or-older than your working tree regardless of which ref you picked.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run compile:webview
scripts.compile: npm run clean && tsc -p ./ && npm run copy:fixtures && npm run copy:codicons
scripts.compile:webview: tsc -p src/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/webview/gitLogLPanel.ts src/webview/diffSearchPanel.ts src/webview/perfBenchmarkPanel.ts src/webview/stonksPanel.ts src/webview/branchCompareSettings.ts --bundle --outdir=media --format=iife --platform=browser
scripts.watch: npm run copy:fixtures && run-p watch:ext watch:webview
scripts.watch:webview: esbuild src/webview/gitLogLPanel.ts src/webview/diffSearchPanel.ts src/webview/perfBenchmarkPanel.ts src/webview/stonksPanel.ts src/webview/branchCompareSettings.ts --bundle --outdir=media --format=iife --platform=browser --watch
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile:webview && npm run lint && npm run ratchet
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:host
